learning.title: Use docker pause, not restart, for server-outage drills on an ephemeral stack
learning.trigger: A reconnect or lost-server drill needs the API unreachable for seconds while a worker runs.
learning.mistake: A container restart on a compose stack with ephemeral published ports can change the host ports, stranding the worker and web origin. A pause of about 28 s also made the worker exit on an HTTP 500 heartbeat, while 15 s survived.
learning.rule: Use `docker pause` then `docker unpause` of the server container, diff `docker port` before and after, and keep pauses at or under 15 s unless proving worker exit. Do not restart containers that hold ephemeral ports.

verification.command: docker port <server container> > before.txt; docker pause <server container>; sleep 3; docker unpause <server container>; docker port <server container> | diff before.txt -
verification.requirement: Record the drill used, the observed worker and attempt states, and the restore result.

learning.boundary: Applies to ephemeral per-worktree stacks only; never drill the shared bakery-main stack.
